issues.quote: $88.1 billion over $72.4 million works out to about 21.7%
issues.problem: There's a unit error: fiscal 2023 net income was $72.4 billion, not $72.4 million. As for the growth rate, both numbers can be explained. The rounded figures give about 21.7% ($88.1B / $72.4B). The reported unrounded figures ($88.136B / $72.361B) give about 21.8%. The fact sheet's +21.8% is correct, so you can include it.

data.summary: The figures in the main analysis match what I know of Microsoft's reported FY2024 and FY2023 results. Revenue was $245.1B vs $211.9B (+15.7%), net income $88.1B vs $72.4B, operating cash flow $118.5B vs $87.6B, total assets $512.2B vs $412.0B, total liabilities $243.7B vs $205.8B, and cash and equivalents $18.3B vs $34.7B. The only error is in the note, which says "$72.4 million" when it should be billion. The +21.8% net income growth on the fact sheet is right: it comes from the unrounded figures, while 21.7% is just a rounding artifact.
